tagline: Bala mumyaambo yoonse. Kokkala koli muuba.
selectionHint: Sala bbala, kaambyo, naa muncali. Ulakonzya alimwi kutyanka kululyo.
appHint: Busanduluzi bwa interface bulabikkwa antoomwe kakunyina intaneti. Zimwi zyakasandululwa amunchina. Mazina aamwaambo alatobela mwaambo wa app wasalwa.
fallback: Kuti Bing yaalilwa, ssola Google (itumina lugwalo kuli Google)
dynamicHint: Zintu zilibonya zilabikkwa mubusena bwakusaanguna. Ima kugwisya basikulangilila.
languageReset: Mwaambo wakaindi tuukonzyi kujanika kuli injini eeyi; kusala mwaambo kwakacincwa.
message1: Ikkoodi yamwaambo tiibeleki pe. Belesya id, en, ja, zh-CN, azimwi.
message3: Zuzya kkii ya API ya sikupa muZyakuchita.
message6: Sikupa tapilusyi busanduluzi pe. Langa nzila, mwaambo, antoomwe amweelwe.
message9: Mweelwe wazyintu zyakazwa mu Bing tazyeendelani pe.
message10: Zyakazwa mubbuku lya Bing tazili kabotu pe.
message12: Malembe aatakwe chintu naakuti mabala aayinda ku 12,000.
message34: Sikupa ulachincha nzila yakulemba. Bbuloki lyakusaanguna lyakazumanana.
message38: Zitondezyo taziliko pe kuzintu zyakazwa. Bbuloki lyakusaanguna lyakazumanana.
message44: Sikupa wakaalilwa muzibeela zyotatwe. Dina kusandulula kuti usole alimwi.
message49: Mweelwe wakuyeeyela makani wasika. Bweedezya peeji katanazumanana.
message58: Bikka lubo chiyungizyo mpawo ubweze peeji kuti ubweze bbazu lipya.
message61: Bweezya peeji aawo chiyungizyo chipya nichabambululwa.
